description: Free: identifies an ERC-20 contract by returning its name, symbol, decimals and total supply, whether it has an owner() and whether it is an EIP-1967 proxy. Use it to confirm which token a contract address really is (for example before trading or listing it) or to get decimals for amount math. For price, liquidity and risk flags use token_snapshot. Read-only. The address is sent to the hosted DevX API, which reads the contract over public RPC at the latest block. No key, no payment. Returns: ok, chain, chain_id, block, token {address, name, symbol, decimals, total_supply as a decimal string}, has_owner, is_eip1967_proxy and full (URL of the paid snapshot). Errors if the address is not an ERC-20 on that chain.

chain.description: Chain the contract is deployed on. Default: base.

token.description: ERC-20 contract address: 0x followed by 40 hex characters (not a symbol or name).
